scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:shared && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:tests
scripts.metrics:coupling: depcruise packages/api/src packages/web/src packages/shared/src -c metrics/dependency-cruiser.cjs --metrics -T metrics
scripts.metrics:complexity: eslint --config metrics/complexity.mjs packages/api/src/app.ts packages/api/src/lib/mistral.ts packages/api/src/db/placesRepository.ts packages/api/src/db/savedRoutesRepository.ts packages/web/src/utils/geo.ts
scripts.import:pamatyklietuvoje: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --dir packages/api import:pamatyklietuvoje
scripts.quality:api: OPENROUTE_API_KEY= MISTRAL_API_KEY= pnpm --dir packages/api exec tsx src/server.ts
scripts.quality:api:ors-fault: OPENROUTE_API_KEY=fake MISTRAL_API_KEY= pnpm --dir packages/api exec tsx --import ../../quality/fault-tolerance/ors-fault.mjs src/server.ts
scripts.quality:web: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:web && pnpm --dir packages/web exec vite preview --port 4173 --strictPort
